Changing branches
Hi everyone, we submitted application to MH in May but my partner still had his old address and it went to the wrong MH. 

He sent request to update his address today. Can anyone tell how long it might take to change branch? Do we put any other special request for that? 

Is there some way to know that branch has been updated? 

Will it take another 3-6 months of processing in new branch? 

Should we go visit the right branch to speed up the process?
